content.short: Parallel is a sci-fi trading card game focused on truly owning cards and other game assets.
content.description: Parallel is a sci-fi trading card game that lets collectors truly own their cards and other game items. It builds a library of assets that unlocks more ways to play and enables players to reuse assets in future Parallel titles. The project leverages blockchain and NFT technology to deploy its intellectual property as cards, games, comics, movies, and more, merging blockchain with traditional entertainment and giving users ownership of parts of the digital worlds they grow to love.
